name: Corporate Action Status
definition: Status of the corporate action process.

AgentStandingInstructionStatus.name: Agent Standing Instruction Status
AgentStandingInstructionStatus.definition: Specifies the state or the condition.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the details of the event.

EventProcessingStatus.name: Event Processing Status
EventProcessingStatus.definition: Processing status of the corporate action event.

InstructionCancellationStatus.name: Instruction Cancellation Status
InstructionCancellationStatus.definition: Status of the instruction cancellation process.

CorporateActionInstructionProcessingStat.name: Corporate Action Instruction Processing Status
CorporateActionInstructionProcessingStat.definition: Status of the corporate action instruction process.

RateStatus.name: Rate Status
RateStatus.definition: Specifies whether the rate is indicative or actual.

EventStatus.name: Event Status
EventStatus.definition: Status of the corporate action event.

RelatedInstructionProcessedStatus.name: Related Instruction Processed Status
RelatedInstructionProcessedStatus.definition: Information on the status of the processing of an instruction related to a corporate action.

DeactivationDateAndTime.name: Deactivation Date And Time
DeactivationDateAndTime.definition: Date and time at which the the corporate action event or the option is deactivated.

EventConfirmationStatus.name: Event Confirmation Status
EventConfirmationStatus.definition: Indicates the status of the occurrence of an event.

EventCompletenessStatus.name: Event Completeness Status
EventCompletenessStatus.definition: Indicates whether the details provided about an event are complete or incomplete.

CorporateActionStatusReason.name: Corporate Action Status Reason
CorporateActionStatusReason.definition: Specifies the reasons for the status. It is derived from the relationship between Status and Status Reason.

CorporateActionEvent.name: Corporate Action Event
CorporateActionEvent.definition: Corporate event for which a status is provided.
